-- we can detect overtakes. Let's look at a specific race with more detail
-- For each driver, compare consecutive laps to find position changes
WITH pos_changes AS (
  SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position, 
         LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) as prev_position
  FROM lap_positions 
  WHERE lap_type = 'Race' 
    AND race_id = 1
)
SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, prev_position, position,
       CASE WHEN prev_position IS NOT NULL THEN 
         CASE WHEN position < prev_position THEN 'Overtaken' -- position improved (lower number)
              WHEN position > prev_position THEN 'Overtake' -- position worsened (higher number)
              ELSE 'No change' END
       ELSE 'First lap' END as change_type
FROM pos_changes
ORDER BY lap, driver_id
LIMIT 40"}

-- Step 1: Get position changes for race laps, excluding lap 1 and retirement types
-- Step 2: Exclude pit stop affected laps
-- Step 3: Count overtakes and being overtaken per driver across all races

WITH 
-- Get all pit stop affected laps (pit entry lap and next lap)

  SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, 
         lap as affected_lap
  FROM pit_stops
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, 
         lap + 1 as affected_lap
  FROM pit_stops
),
-- Get position changes for race laps
pos_changes AS (
  SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position, 
         LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) as prev_position
  FROM lap_positions 
  WHERE lap_type = 'Race' 
    AND lap > 1
),
-- Determine change type and filter out pit stop affected and retirement-related
filtered_changes AS (
  SELECT pc.race_id, pc.driver_id, pc.lap, pc.prev_position, pc.position,
         CASE WHEN pc.position < pc.prev_position THEN 'Overtake' 
              WHEN pc.position > pc.prev_position THEN 'Overtaken' 
              ELSE 'No change' END as change_type
  FROM pos_changes pc
  LEFT JOIN pit_affected_laps pa 
    ON pc.race_id = pa.race_id 
    AND pc.driver_id = pa.driver_id 
    AND pc.lap = pa.affected_lap
  WHERE pc.prev_position IS NOT NULL
    AND pc.change_type IN ('Overtake', 'Overtaken')
    AND pa.affected_lap IS NULL  -- exclude pit stop affected laps
)
SELECT driver_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN change_type = 'Overtake' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_overtakes,
       SUM(CASE WHEN change_type = 'Overtaken' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_overtaken_by_others
FROM filtered_changes
GROUP BY driver_id
ORDER BY driver_id
LIMIT 20"}
